name: Olympus Pen F
note: Name collision between the 1963 half-frame FILM SLR and the 2016 digital PEN-F. The record is the film body by every identity field (body_type slr, medium film, format 35mm, frame 18×24mm, mount 'Olympus Pen F') but had absorbed the digital camera's spec sheet: sensor_format Four-Thirds, sensor_tech CMOS, 20.3MP, ISO 80-25600, shutter 1/8000-60s, auto/program modes. The 1963 body is a fully mechanical rotary focal-plane SLR, 1-1/500 + B, manual exposure only. Digital-only fields blanked. NOT touching metered/meter_type: the record's existing metered=0 is correct (the Pen F has no built-in meter; the Pen FT of 1966 added TTL CdS) and an overlay assertion there would be a regression. 2026-07-29 identity audit.

name: Nikon 1
note: 2011 digital mirrorless line on the 1-inch CX sensor. The record carried lens_mount 'Nikon F' — the F-mount belongs to the 1948 Nikon Model I rangefinder and to the SLR line, never to the Nikon 1, which uses the proprietary Nikon 1 (CX) mount. sensor_tech was 'CCD'; every Nikon 1 body used CMOS. frame_size '24×32 mm' contradicted the 1-inch sensor it also claimed. NOTE: this record is plausibly a SERIES/system page rather than a model (there is no camera simply called 'Nikon 1' — the bodies are J1/V1/S1/AW1). Flagged for the entity_kind pass; these three fixes are correct either way. 2026-07-29 identity audit.

name: Canon PowerShot S110
note: Two different Canon products share this name: the 2001 PowerShot S110 Digital ELPH (2.1MP CCD, 1/2.7", 35-70mm f/2.8-4.0) and the 2012 PowerShot S110 (12.1MP CMOS, 1/1.7", 24-120mm f/2.0-5.9). The record's identity fields are the 2001 one (year_introduced 2001, year_discontinued 2002) but its sensor and lens facts came from the 2012 one. Made internally consistent as the 2001 camera, which is what its own dates say. shutter_speeds blanked: it held 'Auto, ISO 80-6400 (in 1/3-step increments)', an ISO range in a shutter field. lens_type also corrected — it said 'prime' for a 2x zoom. The 2012 body still has no record of its own; that needs the split mechanism, and is in the review queue. 2026-07-29 identity audit.

name: Canon PowerShot S200
note: Same pattern as the S110: the 2002 PowerShot S200 Digital ELPH / Digital IXUS v2 (2.0MP CCD, 1/2.7", 35-70mm) versus the 2013 PowerShot S200 (10.1MP, 24-120mm). The record's dates are 2002-2003 and its sensor facts were the later camera's. Made consistent as the 2002 model. sensor_size was literally 'CCD' — a technology, not a size — so the dimension moves to sensor_size and the technology to sensor_tech. shutter_speeds blanked: it held an ISO range. The later body needs its own record via the split mechanism; review queue. 2026-07-29 identity audit.
